description: A dim cave mouth frames a dusky coastal plain under a cloudy sky with orange light near the horizon and a sea on the left. Three figures in fur and hide sit around a small fire at the base of the rock wall; the one on the right has a hand on the shoulder of the one beside them, and the one in the foreground is crouched with its back mostly turned. Rough, painterly oil style with no visible text, signature or border.
